name: Seated Daoist Sage and Three Attendants in a Landscape
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；14th century；Fragment of a wall painting: ink and colors on a white-washed clay ground. Probably from a Daoist temple in Shanxi province, style of Yonglegong.
